ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, within circle $\odot O$, $OC \perp AB$, and $\angle ADC=32^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle OBA$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since in circle $O$, $OC\perp AB$,\\
it follows that $\overset{\frown}{AC}=\overset{\frown}{BC}$, and $\angle BOC+\angle OBA=90^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle BOC=2\angle ADC=64^\circ$,\\
hence $\angle OBA=90^\circ-\angle BOC=90^\circ-64^\circ=\boxed{26^\circ}$.

From the text, use OC ⟂ AB and ∠ADC = 32°. Since a radius/diameter line from the center perpendicular to chord AB bisects the chord and the intercepted arc, C is the midpoint of minor arc AB, so arc AC = arc BC. The inscribed angle ∠ADC subtends arc AC, so arc AC has measure 64°. Therefore arc BC also has measure 64°, and the central angle ∠BOC is 64°. Because OC is perpendicular to AB, the angle between OB and AB is complementary to ∠BOC, so ∠OBA = 90° − 64° = 26°.
